parsed.name: 串口转 I2C 桥接器
parsed.description: 一种基于 Arduino 的串口到 I2C 通信桥接设备，用于在实验系统中通过串口与 I2C 总线外设通信、读写寄存器并检查总线连接状态。
parsed.description_en: An Arduino-based serial-to-I2C communication bridge used in laboratory setups to access I2C bus peripherals over a serial link, read and write registers, and verify bus connectivity.

actions.description: 获取/设置目标 I2C 设备地址。
actions.description_en: Get/set the target I2C device address.

actions.description: 发送 I2C 查询消息并检查传输返回状态。
actions.description_en: Send an I2C query message and check the transmission return status.

actions.description: 读取指定 I2C 寄存器的数据。
actions.description_en: Read data from the specified I2C register.

actions.description: 向指定 I2C 寄存器写入数据。
actions.description_en: Write data to the specified I2C register.

actions.description: 检查桥接器到 I2C 总线设备的连接是否正常。
actions.description_en: Check whether the connection from the bridge to the I2C bus device is working properly.
